I found three date picker examples in `@shadcn`:

| Registry item | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `@shadcn/date-picker-demo` | Select a single date |
| `@shadcn/date-picker-with-range` | Select a start and end date |
| `@shadcn/date-picker-with-presets` | Select a date using preset shortcuts |

The examples build on `Calendar` and `Popover`. [shadcn/ui Date Picker docs for Radix](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/radix/date-picker)
